description: Get one saved connector by `id`: name, type, targetRef and its connection settings, as in listDigitalConnectors. Use when: a digital test config names a connectorId and you want to say which bot it reaches. Read-only. Needs digital:read. Returns 404 if the connector is not in your workspace.
name: getDigitalConnector

config.description:
The target object minus `transport`. Validated against the schema for
`type` — see `GET /digital-testing/connector-types` for the fields each
type accepts.

targetRef.description:
Immutable after creation — the stable key compliance reports aggregate
on. Renaming a connector must never split its report history.

type.description: Immutable after creation — determines every field in `config`.

typeUpdatedAt.description: Derived range key (`{type}#{updatedAt}`). Never accepted from a caller.

title: Get Digital Connector
